segments.title: Pre-Stream Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the pre-show with a freestyle rap about immortality, bodily fluids, and Daffy Duck graphics before expiring; Case acknowledges sub milestones and tests new channel-point graphics.

segments.title: BrainBridge Head-Transplant Machine
segments.notes: Case reads an Instagram-reel pitch for an AI-driven robotic head-transplant startup; the word "science" triggers a mandatory Chet Guy the Science Eyes intervention where Chet dissects the video frame-by-frame and volunteers Case for the first human trial.

segments.title: Discord Poll Debate
segments.notes: A surprise two-minute debate erupts over launching a standalone BIN Discord; Crum claims his first on-air win, Munch appears under the alias "Al Manchester," and the pair exit once the poll closes in favor of yes.

segments.title: How To Slow Down Time Perception
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget debuts his instructional desk, guiding chat through a YouTube clock-staring exercise that subjectively dilates five minutes into ten while revealing his wife Jebra has died and his father haunts a wooden board.

segments.title: Wrap-Up and Raid
segments.notes: Case aborts a raid attempt, resets, confirms a gaming stream with Fiona tomorrow, and raids Gina off the virtual camera.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a truncated pre-Patreon broadcast, tests new graphics and a prospective BIN Discord, and fields a chaotic Hype Train pre-show.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Derails the pre-stream with a freestyle rap about bodily fluids and immortality before expiring on air.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: recurring. Invades the News desk via the "science" trigger to dissect BrainBridge's head-transplant video and volunteer Case for the first human trial.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: recurring. Briefly debates the merits of a standalone BIN Discord against Munch, claiming a first-ever on-air win.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: recurring. Spars with Crum over the Discord poll, denies being "Ralph" under the alias "Al Manchester," and exits to clear the deck for the How To segment.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Debuts his instructional desk by guiding the audience through a YouTube tutorial on slowing subjective time perception while revealing his wife Jebra has died and his father haunts a wooden board.

lore_notes.fact: Case proposes launching a dedicated BIN Discord separate from the Cream Team server to organize segment submissions.
Chet claims he is "in the lab" and that his craft is "making numbers rhyme," not rap.
Jeb Nogget reveals his deceased wife's name was Jebra and calls her a "beautiful dead Jebra."
Jeb confirms his father's spirit is permanently trapped inside a wooden board in his workshop.
Jeb demonstrates a subjective time-dilation technique, claiming the method altered his perception so that five minutes felt like ten to twenty.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a brief pre-Patreon broadcast featuring a chaotic Hype Train pre-show, a News segment on BrainBridge's AI-powered head-transplant machine that triggers Chet Manscape's mandatory science intervention, a surprise Munch & Crum debate over a standalone BIN Discord, and the series debut of Jeb Nogget's "How To" desk teaching subjective time dilation. The stream ends with a raid to Gina.
